text_block_list.text: One day, as the Aoba Sho drew near—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...My pace distribution for 2400m has 
stabilized. ...Now, I need to identify the 
uncertain variables again and develop 
response patterns—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Ah, um! Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Zenno Rob Roy. Thoughtful, hardworking, 
and earnest in her library committee 
duties—a junior with so much to admire.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(She hasn't debuted yet. But surely, once 
she debuts, she'll shine as a brilliantly 
talented Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to interrupt your solo training. 
Um... there's just something I really 
wanted to ask you, Kris S-san—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Something you want to ask?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why— Why are you running in the Aoba Sho?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your ultimate goal is the Japan 
Derby, right, Kris S-san...? But... in the 
Aoba Sho—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Jinx. ――If you mean that, I am aware of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—the first goal. Our primary target 
is—the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So, in order to win—I've made the Aoba 
Sho—my intermediate goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...After considering—various factors— I 
have chosen—the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Whether a jinx exists or not... 
doesn't matter. What's important is that I 
deliver 'results.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Did that... answer your question, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! I understood very clearly...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, the Aoba Sho! And the Japanese Derby 
too— I'll be there to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please let me watch by your side as you 
deliver "results," Kris S-san...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thanks. ...I will give it my all.
And then came the day of the Aoba Sho—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I wonder how today's Aoba Sho will 
go. Symboli Kris S seems to be favored, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look at her, wearing that cold expression 
again. I don't know if she's just 
confident she'll win or what.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Kris S-san. I want to see it. You, 
transcending adversity and common 
sense...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Surely... that figure was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what about you, Kris S? Is it 
"now"? Or is it... "later"?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to measure it. Before the 'Fated 
Day' arrives."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Well then, I'm heading out.
choice_data_list: Let's go at it just like usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —As always, I'll deliver results.
